app.title: Time booking
app.tagline: Every hour you buy, in view: book time, check budgets, reorder in time.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in with your business email address.
login.noAccount: No account yet? Your admin creates it for you.

users.description: All accounts. Only admins create accounts – there is no self-registration.
users.newDescription: Create an account and hand the initial password to the person yourself.
users.name: Name
users.supplierHint: Consultants always belong to a supplier.

audit.description: Every action in the API: who, what, on what, with which result and why – newest first. Tap a row for all details.
audit.loadFailed: The audit log could not be loaded

suppliers.description: The companies orders are placed with. Tap a name to change it.
suppliers.newDescription: Add a company you order services from.
suppliers.renameDescription: The new name applies at once to all orders and consultants of this company.
suppliers.name: Name

orders.description: All orders with their budget – sums only, no single bookings. Tap an order to change it.
orders.newDescription: Order services from a supplier, with a budget and a period.
orders.editBooked: {{hours}} are already booked on this order: the budget cannot shrink below that, the supplier is fixed, and the period must include all bookings.
orders.title: Title
orders.supplierLocked: Time has been booked – the supplier can no longer be changed.

errors.DAILY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Booking rejected: more than 10 hours of work per day are not allowed (ArbZG §3).
errors.BUDGET_EXCEEDED: Booking rejected: the free budget of this order is not enough.
errors.INVALID_DURATION: Booking rejected: the duration must be a positive number of whole minutes.
errors.ORDER_NOT_FOUND: Booking rejected: this order does not exist.
errors.ORDER_NOT_ASSIGNED: Booking rejected: you can only book on orders of your own company.
errors.DATE_IN_FUTURE: Booking rejected: the date is in the future. Book time once the work is done.
errors.NOT_YOUR_ORDER: Only the project manager of this order can see its budget.
errors.INVALID_JSON: The request could not be read.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again.
errors.CONSULTANT_NEEDS_SUPPLIER: A consultant must belong to a supplier. Choose the consultant's company.
errors.SUPPLIER_ONLY_FOR_CONSULTANTS: Only consultants belong to a supplier. Project managers, purchasing and admins work for the client; leave the supplier empty.
errors.EMAIL_TAKEN: An account with this email address already exists.
errors.SUNDAY_OR_HOLIDAY: Booking rejected: no work on Sundays and public holidays (German Working Time Act §9).
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Please enter a valid email address and a password.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: The server cannot be reached. Is the API running?
errors.FORBIDDEN: Your role is not allowed to do this.
errors.SUPPLIER_NAME_TAKEN: A supplier with this name already exists.
errors.ORDER_CODE_TAKEN: An order with this order number already exists.
errors.ORDER_PERIOD_INVALID: The period cannot end before it starts.
errors.NOT_A_PROJECT_MANAGER: Only a project manager can be responsible for an order.
errors.BUDGET_BELOW_BOOKED: More time is already booked on this order – the budget cannot be smaller.
errors.SUPPLIER_FIXED_AFTER_BOOKINGS: Time has already been booked on this order, so it stays with its supplier. Create a new order instead.
errors.PERIOD_EXCLUDES_BOOKINGS: There are bookings outside this period. The period must include every booked day.
errors.OUTSIDE_ORDER_PERIOD: Booking rejected: the date is outside the period of this order.
